text.tspan: Users build apps with the mRPC library and the
compiled protocol stub. The app connects to the
mRPC service, specifying protocols of interest.
The mRPC service compiles and loads a library
Users invoke RPCs using familiar function stubs,
while the mRPC library handles allocations and
dispatching RPCs through shared memory. The
mRPC service implements the RPC processing logic
with minimal copies and marshaling of data.
Operators manage RPC services by applying
processing logic. All of this can be done without
